subject: SIG initiation request — MedlySys: clarifying scope, ownership, and kickoff
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Alex Jenkins <alex.jenkins@medlysys.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-03T14:12:00-07:00
Subject: SIG initiation request — MedlySys: clarifying scope, ownership, and kickoff

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for taking the call earlier. Quick recap and a few clarifying questions so we can kick off the SIG/CAIQ work cleanly: 

- Ask: Confirm whether MedlySys prefers a SIG Lite (standard CAIQ) submission or a full SIG questionnaire for your procurement team. We can prefill CAIQ fields to speed things up.
- SOC 2: Can you share current status? (report date or expected in-progress audit window).
- Regulatory scope: You mentioned HIPAA for a subset of customers — which product lines/tenants will need HIPAA-specific evidence? Any GDPR residency constraints?
- Key management: Do you expect BYOK (customer-managed keys) or will MedlySys use Redwood-managed keys? If BYOK, do you require HSM/KMS integrations (e.g., AWS KMS, GCP CMEK)?
- Evidence owners & timeline: Who on your side will own evidence collection (names/emails)? What is your target date for the questionnaire completion / procurement milestone?

I've attached a prefill template (redwood-sig-prefill-template.xlsx) that we typically use — fill what you can and we’ll handle the rest. If helpful, we can also do a 30-min kickoff next week to align owners. Suggested windows below.

Proposed kickoff slots (PT):
- Tue 2026-10-06 10:00–10:30
- Wed 2026-10-07 15:30–16:00

Next steps for us: Soojin will lead the CAIQ prefill and Karthik will coordinate SOC 2 evidence mapping once we confirm scope.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this rolling.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Calendly: https://calendly.com/tessa-morgan/redwood-sig-kickoff

Attachments: redwood-sig-prefill-template.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Alex Jenkins <alex.jenkins@medlysys.com>

Date: 2026-10-03T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG initiation request — MedlySys: clarifying scope, ownership, and kickoff

Hi Tessa —

Thanks for the clear recap. A few answers and clarifications from our side: 

- Questionnaire type: Procurement prefers a CAIQ prefill (SIG Lite) initially; they may request a fuller SIG for enterprise deals later. Prefill would speed things up.
- SOC 2: We're currently in the middle of an SOC 2 Type II readiness audit; we expect the report to be available in Q1 2027 (target mid-February).
- HIPAA/GDPR: HIPAA is required for our Clinical product only (tenant ID: CLIN-01). GDPR applies for EU customers — we host EU tenant data in the eu-central region.
- Keys & logs: We ideally want BYOK for Clinical tenant keys and prefer AWS KMS integration. For audit logs, procurement will ask about retention windows and whether logs are accessible to customers or only Redwood ops.
- Evidence owners: I'm the primary contact for kickoffs (alex.jenkins@medlysys.com). Security team will be pulled in for technical evidence (cc'd). Target procurement milestone: internal PO by 2026-11-15 if possible.

Kickoff: Wed 2026-10-07 15:30 PT works for us. Please send an invite.

Alex
Alex Jenkins
Head of IT Security | MedlySys
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0193

Alex —

Great — invite sent for Wed 2026-10-07 15:30 PT. A few quick answers ahead of the call so you have context: 

- BYOK / KMS: We support customer-managed keys in two ways today: Redwood Dedicated (CMEK integrations with AWS KMS) and Redwood Private (customer-managed KMS/HSM). For hosted Redwood API customers we currently offer Redwood-managed keys; BYOK for hosted is on the roadmap (expected experimental release H2 2027). I'll attach our short KMS overview (redwood-kms-overview.pdf).
- Audit logs & retention: We provide tenant-level audit logs with configurable retention (default 90 days, enterprise options to extend to 1 year). Logs for Dedicated/Private can be exported to your SIEM. We'll confirm exact retention SLAs during the kickoff.
- Evidence prefill: Soojin will share the CAIQ draft by EOD Tuesday so you have time to review before the kickoff.
- HubSpot / procurement: I've created the deal in HubSpot: D-8892 and linked it in the invite.

Attachments: redwood-kms-overview.pdf (PDF)

Looking forward to the call.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
